question: At fixed 16-cell occupancy, does enlarging local neighborhood from radius one to two restore a perfect matching in each of six previously consumed R016 stages?
arms: A0 radius one exact Y019 replay
A1 radius two exact Y019 control
controls: six stages and 16 cells per stage
Y019 radius-one matched 0/6 and radius-two matched 6/6
no adaptive search or altered thresholds
metric: for each stage, record maximum bipartite matching cardinality at radius one and two; no additional capacity

classification.supported: all six frozen stages show matching cardinality below 16 at radius one and 16 at radius two
classification.negative: at least one stage fails that comparison while all controls pass
classification.invalid: identity, controls or deterministic replication fails

scope: research-only, consumed synthetic inputs, no admission or accepted-ref change
